newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 RISES, MKT SESS GOVT CONFIDENCE VOTE WIN.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 RISES, MKT SESS GOVT CONFIDENCE VOTE WIN.

text.p: Czech shares continued to rise at Tuesday's price fixing on the Prague bourse led by market expectations that the government would win a confidence vote which will be debated by Parliament on Tuesday afternoon.

"The market, in my opinion, expects that the confidence vote will be in favour of the government...if this expectation is confirmed by the result, then the market should go a little higher still," said Jindrich Weiss of Zivnostenska Banka.
Major issues applied most of the upward pressure. SPT Telecom rose 36 crowns to 3,255 and Komercni Banka gained 60 crowns to 2,060.
There were also some strong gains among the less heavily capitalised shares.
Fat maker Setuza gained 60 crowns to 1,280, drugs maker Leciva was up 99 crowns to 2,298 and glass fibre maker Vertex rose 137 crowns to 2,884.
-- Robin Shepherd, Prague Newsroom, 420-2-2423-0003 For (c) Reuters Limited 1997
